hitPoints.atHigherLevels: 1d8 (or 5) + your Constitution modifier per druid level after 1st

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Drawing on the divine essence of nature itself, you can cast spells to shape that essence to your will. Your spellcasting ability is Wisdom. You prepare the list of druid spells available to cast each day.

features.name: Druidic
features.description: You know Druidic, the secret language of druids. You can speak it and use it to leave hidden messages.

features.name: Wild Shape
features.description: You can use your Wild Shape to transform into a beast you have seen before. You can use this feature twice per short or long rest; at higher levels you gain more uses and can transform into more powerful beasts. You can stay in Wild Shape for a number of hours equal to half your druid level, then revert. You can revert early as a bonus action.

features.name: Wild Companion (Optional 2nd-level feature)
features.description: You can summon a spirit that takes the form of a Beast (CR 1/4 or lower, no flying or swimming speed). It serves you as a mount or guard. Recharges on a long rest.

features.name: Circle Spells
features.description: When you join a druidic Circle, you learn additional spells at specific druid levels.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: You can increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1. Max 20.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn. The extra attack doesn't combine with Wild Shape attacks if carried out in the same Combat Phase.

features.name: Wild Shape Improvement
features.description: You can use Wild Shape to transform into a beast with a CR up to 1/2 and that has a swimming speed.

features.name: Wild Shape Improvement
features.description: You can transform into a beast with a CR up to 1 (and gains flying speed).

features.name: Circle Feature (2nd)
features.description: You gain a feature from your Circle.

features.name: Circle Feature (3rd)
features.description: You gain a feature from your Circle.

features.name: Circle Feature (4th)
features.description: You gain a feature from your Circle.

subclasses.name: Circle of Stars
subclasses.description_en: Your magic draws on the stellar bodies, giving you access to guiding constellations and the path of the cosmos.
subclasses.description_es: Tu magia bebe de los astros, dándote acceso a constelaciones guía y al camino del cosmos.

features.name: Star Map
features.description: Channel Divinity: cast guidance on one creature and know direction to celestial pole.

features.name: Constellation Form
features.description: Choose a constellation: archer (temp HP), chalice (healing), dragon (damage).

features.name: Starlight Step
features.description: Bonus action teleport 30 ft, leaving glowing star.

features.name: Starry Form Improved
features.description: Bonus action to absorb constellation features.

features.name: Wall of Stars
features.description: Cast Wall of Stone at 2nd level once per long rest without spending a slot.

features.name: Cosmic Omen
features.description: Initiative +1d4 cosmic bonus; reroll 1s on Initiative.

subclasses.name: Circle of the Land
subclasses.description_en: Your magic is tied to a particular landscape, granting you special powers based on the land where you were initiated.
subclasses.description_es: Tu magia se vincula a un terreno particular, otorgándote poderes especiales según el lugar de iniciación.

features.name: Circle Spells
features.description: Gain bonus spells based on your terrain (Arctic, Coast, Desert, etc.).

features.name: Natural Recovery
features.description: During a short rest, recover spell slots whose combined levels = half druid level (rounded up), max slot 5th.

features.name: Land's Stride
features.description: Movement through difficult terrain costs no extra; you have resistance to poison damage and ignore poison nonmagical spikes.

features.name: Nature's Ward
features.description: Immune to poison and disease.

features.name: Nature's Sanctuary
features.description: Aberrations, elementals, fey, fiends, undead can't attack you pre-emptively and must save Wis if they do.

subclasses.name: Circle of the Moon
subclasses.description_en: You draw power from the moon, manifesting powerful wild shapes.
subclasses.description_es: Obtienes poder de la luna, manifestando formas salvajes poderosas.

features.name: Combat Wild Shape
features.description: Wild Shape as bonus action; CR up to 1 (4th: 1, 8th: 2, 12th: 3, 16th: 4, 20th: 5).

features.name: Elemental Wild Shape
features.description: Wild Shape into air, earth, fire, or water elemental.

features.name: Primal Strike
features.description: Your beast attacks count as magical.

features.name: Thousand Forms
features.description: Cast Alter Self at will; immunity to being charmed or frightened.

features.name: Capstone
features.description: Wild Shape into creatures with CR 5 with no limited-class restriction.

subclasses.name: Circle of the Sea
subclasses.description_en: Your magic flows from the infinite ocean, granting otherworldly forms and watery powers.
subclasses.description_es: Tu magia fluye del océano infinito, otorgando formas sobrenaturales y poderes acuáticos.

features.name: Call the Hunt
features.description: Bonus action: 5×druid level temp HP and walking speed +10 ft for 10 min.

features.name: Mariner's Senses
features.description: Aquatic animals understand you; fish ignore you.

features.name: Aquatic Predation
features.description: Wild Shape into aquatic cr 1 creatures with swim speeds.

features.name: Relentless Rage
features.description: When you drop to 0 HP in Wild Shape, you can keep fighting!

features.name: Stormy Wild Shape
features.description: Wild Shape into storm elemental-like forms.

features.name: Tempestuous Soul
features.description: Permanent swim speed 60 ft; immune to water damage.

subclasses.name: Circle of the Land
subclasses.description: The Circle of the Land is made up of mystics and sages who safeguard ancient knowledge and rites. Choose a land type (Arctic, Coast, Desert, Forest, Grassland, Mountain, Swamp, or Underdark). You gain spells associated with that land.

features.name: Natural Recovery
features.description: During a short rest, you can recover expended spell slots by drawing on the ambient magic of nature. Combined slot levels recovered cannot exceed half your proficiency bonus (rounded up), and no slot of 6th level or higher can be recovered.

features.name: Land's Stride
features.description: Moving through nonmagical difficult terrain costs no extra movement. You also have advantage on saving throws against plants that are magically created or manipulated to impede movement.

subclasses.name: Circle of the Moon
subclasses.description: Druids of the Moon draw on the primal power of the moon itself. They take the forms of savage predators, transforming into dangerous beasts with remarkable ease.

features.name: Combat Wild Shape
features.description: When you Wild Shape, you can transform into any beast with a CR up to 1 (instead of 1/4). You can also use Wild Shape as a bonus action on your turn.

features.name: Improved Wild Shape (Elementals)
features.description: Starting at 6th level, you can transform into an air elemental, earth elemental, fire elemental, or water elemental using Wild Shape. You ignore the restriction on transformation CR.

features.name: Elemental Wild Shape (CR scaling)
features.description: At 10th level, you can transform into any elemental with a CR up to your druid level / 3.
